title: Fundra
tagline: Fundra is a blockchain-based app for launching projects and receiving secure, transparent donations.
description: Fundra is a cross-platform crowdfunding application powered by blockchain technology. It allows project creators to publish initiatives and receive secure donations from supporters worldwide. By leveraging blockchain, Fundra ensures transparency, trust, and decentralization—enabling donors to track contributions and fostering direct engagement between creators and their communities without intermediaries. Ideal for creative ideas, social causes, or tech innovations, Fundra offers an open and reliable platform to connect projects with backers and bring ambitious visions to life.
how_its_made:
Fundra is built using .NET Core, enabling deployment across Windows, Linux, macOS, Browser (WebAssembly), Android, and iOS. The project uses Ethereum smart contracts for handling donations and IPFS for decentralized data storage.

All platform logic is shared through a single .NET codebase, with platform-specific UI layers. Integration with Web3 allows secure, transparent transactions without centralized servers.
